title: Ohio Cannabis Ecosystem Directory
description: A source-verified directory of organizations operating in or serving the Ohio cannabis market: operators, service providers and nonprofits, categorized with capability keywords for problem-oriented search. Each record carries the source used to verify it and the seed source recording how it entered the dataset. Organizations that close, merge or rename are retained out of scope rather than deleted, so historical references remain resolvable. This release contains 556 records: 510 publishable organizations across 16 categories and 46 retained out-of-scope records. Release 4.5 includes a pre-rendered home-screen card for confirmed events within the next three months, the Midwest CannaWomen community spotlight, corrected consolidated categories, and an Ohio State scarlet-and-gray palette.
